threads.title: Who Was Still There?
threads.intro: Find who was in the workshop and which entry records are RFID-backed.
threads.outcome_text: Five Team Pulse members appear after 9:20 PM, and three had main-door RFID entries before Arjun was found.

threads.title: The Fault and the Alibi
threads.intro: See who received the fault report and test Nikhil’s account against independent records.
threads.outcome_text: Nikhil’s laptop and badge records place him in Seminar Hall 2, and the warning was delivered to Rohit, Arjun and Kavya.

threads.title: Seven Minutes Late
threads.intro: Correct the controller and camera clocks and match the events across systems.
threads.outcome_text: The corrected controller and camera times agree at 21:32, and the rear door explains the missing RFID entry.

story_events.title: Three entries
story_events.body: Nikhil, Sameer and Arjun have RFID entries on the main workshop door after 21:20. Kavya had already left at 20:43 after disconnecting Module 04 and filing her report.

story_events.title: Who was told
story_events.body: The Module 04 warning was delivered to Rohit, Arjun and Kavya at 20:47 and opened by each of them. Nikhil’s device and badge records place him in Seminar Hall 2 from 21:42.

story_events.title: Three clocks
story_events.body: The workshop log is the reference clock. The controller runs 3 minutes slow and the corridor camera 4 minutes fast. Corrected, the controller ON at 21:29 and the rear-door motion at displayed 21:36 are both 21:32.
